title: "Three mechanisms of language comprehension - implications for human evolution" by Andrey Vyshedskiy
excerpt: This is a ~1 hour talk and Q&A given by neuroscientist Andrey Vyshedskiy (https://www.bu.edu/prsocial/profile/andrey-vyshedskiy/, https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Ury0hsMAAAAJ&hl=en) in our Center on the origin of language in humans.
